extraction_notes:
This is an Allstate Benefits "Self-Funded Medical Plan Proposal" (level-funded/self-funded stop-loss program, administered via Allied Benefit / stop-loss by Integon or National Health Insurance Co). Document structure across ~50 pages:

1. Cover page (page 1): agent/rep info, group name ("Proposal For"), proposal date.
2. "About Allstate Benefits" marketing page (page 2) - ignore.
3. Plan/Rate Summary table (pages 3-6): a wide grid with Plan 1-3 on one page (page 3) and Plan 4 continued on page 5 due to page width - ALWAYS check for a "Plans quoted in this proposal: N" note to confirm total count (here N=4). This table gives Individual/Family Deductible (in-network/out-of-network combined in one cell, must split), Coinsurance, Total Ind/Fam OOP Max, PCP/Specialist copay, Telemedicine vendors, Urgent Care, Medical Network (varies by plan - some plans use Cigna OAP, others Aetna Signature Administrators PPO), OP Surgery, PBM, Rx tiers, DXL, ER, AME, deductible accrual period, run-out period, HSA eligibility, wellness, Papa Caregiver hours, Cancer Coach, Dental/Vision (usually "No" - this is medical only quote), and Total Cost (monthly premium total for the group).
4. Stop-Loss Insurance and Financial Details (page 7): per-plan specific/aggregate attachment points and Monthly Bill Medical rate tiers (Employee, Employee+Spouse, Employee+Child, Family) - this is the RATE TABLE, use these four tiers as the "rates" fields (employee_only, employee_spouse, employee_children, family).
5. Employee Census (pages 8-9): enrollment counts per plan/tier and per-employee cost breakdown - useful to confirm rates and tier enrollment counts but not needed for schema beyond rates.
6. Benefit Summary detail pages (one plan per ~2 pages, e.g. pages 10-17 for 4 plans): gives full per-plan benefit detail including individual/family deductible in/out-of-network, coinsurance %, coinsurance-only OOP max (separate from "Total" OOP max which includes copays), lifetime max, office visit copay split PCP/specialist, telemedicine vendors detail, Rx tiers, preventive care, urgent care, diagnostic/imaging, ER, maternity, outpatient PT (visit limits), home health/subacute rehab/inpatient rehab (visit/day limits), transplants, behavioral health inpatient/outpatient (coinsurance % differs by plan - lower deductible plans had 70% BH coinsurance, higher deductible Aetna plans had 50%), and general hospital/physician/DME. THIS is the richest source for the "benefits" map - use it as primary source, supplement with Plan/Rate summary page for fields not in Benefit Summary (Papa Caregiver, Cancer Coach, HSA, wellness, run-out period, delayed admin fee).
7. Additional Information/Exclusion Summary (page 18): general exclusions applicable to ALL plans - not plan specific, can be ignored for structured extraction but useful for notes.
8. SBC (Summary of Benefits and Coverage) documents (pages 19-50, ~8 pages per plan x 4 plans = 32 pages): standard federal SBC format per plan, gives detailed cost-sharing grid (participating vs non-participating) for many additional benefit categories not in the Benefit Summary: diagnostic tests, imaging, Rx tiers 1-4 with mail order, outpatient surgery facility/physician fees, ER/urgent care/ambulance, hospital stay facility/physician, mental health inpatient/outpatient, pregnancy, home health/rehab/habilitation/skilled nursing/DME/hospice, children's dental/eye (not covered), excluded services list, and coverage examples (Joe/Peg/Mia scenarios - NOT needed for extraction, skip). These SBCs confirm/duplicate deductible and OOP max figures already in Benefit Summary and Plan/Rate summary - use to fill any gaps (e.g. exact ER coinsurance is 20%/20% par/non-par per SBC despite "deductible and coinsurance" generic label in Benefit Summary; imaging/diagnostic test coinsurance is 20%/50%).

IMPORTANT: This document type only contains ONE product (Medical / self-funded PPO copay plans) - there is no dental/vision/other product to filter out in this particular document, but future documents from this carrier may bundle Dental/Vision quotes alongside Medical (the Plan/Rate summary explicitly has Dental/Vision rows, both "No" in this instance) - only extract Medical rows/plans if other products appear.

Total plan count in this document: 4 (Plan 1, Plan 2, Plan 3, Plan 4), all "Traditional" self-funded PPO copay plans, embedded deductible. Rate tiers offered: Employee, Employee+Spouse, Employee+Child, Family (4 tiers, all groups had 0 enrolled in EE+Spouse and Family tiers here but tiers/rates are still quoted for all 4).
